feature: Give the factory its own discovery of repo instructions (see docs/repo-instructions-brief.md, run 1): add a deterministic, stdlib-only scanner to the factory CLI that reads git objects at the run's ref and indexes tracked agent instruction files at any depth from a table-driven catalogue, governance documents, @path imports and one-hop links; classify each entry as always, scoped or reference with its scope, size, hash and title; read instructions.include, instructions.reference and instructions.exclude from .factory/config.json; add the read-only `factory instructions` report and the `factory instructions-record` writer, which stores a summary in run state, writes the index file in the run folder and reports the delta on a re-record; call the writer at every preflight after profile-record and disclose counts, sizes, notes, the over-32-KiB warning and the no-instructions case; have the orchestrator read the always entries at preflight and grill and take documented build and test commands from every root-scope entry; record the new terms in CONTEXT.md and the decision as ADR 0019; add this repository's own config lists; and cover the scanner with unit tests over fixture trees.

commands.build: export FACTORY_HOME="$(mktemp -d)"; for h in claude-code opencode codex copilot zcode; do python3 tools/render.py "$h" || exit 1; done; test -z "$(git ls-files -- dist/)" && bash -n install.sh

decisions.question: setup-commands
decisions.answer: No root CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md; commands from README CI line + .github/workflows/ci.yml. build: render five harnesses with FACTORY_HOME=$(mktemp -d), fail if dist/ tracked, bash -n install.sh; test: python3 -m unittest discover -s tools

decisions.question: Q1
decisions.answer: full chain (source brief Q27; its run-1 invocation is /factory --full)

decisions.question: Q2
decisions.answer: ADR 0020, not 0019: origin/024-windows-install already adds docs/adr/0019-the-installer-is-a-python-module.md; if 0020 is taken at implement time, use the next number free on origin/main and every remote branch

decisions.question: Q3
decisions.answer: docs/repo-instructions-brief.md is staged only in the main checkout and absent from origin/main; the run neither adds nor edits it; its full text is reproduced in brief.md; spec.md and plan.md stay self-contained

decisions.question: Q4
decisions.answer: Scope is run 1 (discovery) only; run 2 consumption items stay out; the brief open points (other tools config file names, ADR directory patterns, index file name and format) are settled at clarify/plan

decisions.question: Q1
decisions.answer: A: No, config lists only - the scanner ignores other tools' config files (opencode.json instructions, Codex project_doc_fallback_filenames, Gemini context.fileName, Aider read:); owners add such files through instructions.include

decisions.question: Q2
decisions.answer: A: Per-tool catalogue default - each catalogue row records the tool's documented default kind and its front-matter-to-kind mapping (always-apply flag = always; globs/paths/applyTo/fileMatch = scoped; description-only, manual, model-decision and mode-specific = reference); absent or unparseable front matter takes the row default

decisions.question: Q3
decisions.answer: A: Regular file, others as aliases - same content at the same scope is one entry carrying the regular file's path (the symlink target); for identical regular copies the lexicographically first path; other paths go in the entry's aliases field

decisions.question: Q4
decisions.answer: A: Exclude, then config, then strongest - instructions.exclude drops the file; else instructions.include (always, root scope) beats instructions.reference; else the strongest derived kind wins (always > scoped > reference), ties broken catalogue/governance > import > link

decisions.question: Q5
decisions.answer: A: instructions.json - one JSON file with ref, combined hash, notes and ordered entries (path, kind, scope, size, hash, title, aliases); sorted keys, stable entry order; beside the pending file before the worktree exists, then in <spec_dir>/factory/ beside profile.md

decisions.question: Q5
decisions.answer: A: Self-contained Input line - drop the factory/brief.md pointer; say settled decisions are under Clarifications; name docs/repo-instructions-brief.md as background only, outside this change

decisions.question: Q6
decisions.answer: A: Follow from always/scoped only - imports and links are followed only from always and scoped entries (including imported ones); reference entries are leaves. Import = @ token at line start or after whitespace, outside code spans and fenced blocks; link = Markdown inline or reference-style link outside code, anchors stripped, resolved against the file's directory

decisions.question: Q7
decisions.answer: A: Root locations always, nested scoped - CONTRIBUTING* at the root, .github/ or docs/ is always with root scope; elsewhere scoped to its own directory subtree; the constitution is matched only at .specify/memory/constitution.md

decisions.question: Q8
decisions.answer: A: Read at the recorded ref - the orchestrator reads each always entry at the index's recorded ref (git show <ref>:<path>) so content matches the recorded hash; after step 4 the worktree copy at HEAD is the same content

decisions.question: Q9
decisions.answer: A: Agent files first, then confirm - root catalogue agent files win over governance and include entries; a remaining same-tier conflict goes into the existing setup-commands confirmation (under cruise: first entry in index order, recorded with the existing setup-commands decision)

decisions.question: Q10
decisions.answer: A: Path identity; hash, kind, scope - entries match by path; changed = different hash, kind or scope; alias-only and title-only differences are not changes

decisions.question: Q1
decisions.answer: A: Accept as declared - seams S1-S6 with exactly the declared failure paths: S1 factory instructions F1.1-F1.9; S2 factory instructions-record F2.1-F2.4; S3 factory adopt F3.1; S4 factory validate F4.1; S5 factory drop none; S6 SKILL.md text contract none; exempt: DESIGN.md, references/state.md, config README text in models.py, .factory/config.json, CONTEXT.md, the ADR
